Footer Description: Token Hub is an OpenRouter-style AI model aggregation and distribution platform — one OpenAI-compatible API to access 400+ models with multi-model orchestration and self-hosted compute.
Disclaimer: Third-party models are provided by their respective vendors; Token Hub only provides aggregation and distribution.
Hero Subtitle: Token Hub gives enterprise Agents a unified model control plane: connect to multiple models through one interface, keeping routing, reliability, cost and governance within a boundary your team can see and manage.
Metric 4 Desc: Long-term reports built on daily aggregation
Toolchain Title: Built for your team's existing toolchain
Product Subtitle: More than API forwarding — the operations interface for your team's models. From a single request to a stable AI workflow, key facts no longer scatter across clients, vendor consoles and ad-hoc spreadsheets.
Product Card 1 Desc: Policies live at the gateway; clients don't need to reconfigure. Set priority, weight and fallback paths per model alias — vendor fluctuations, model switches and cost choices no longer leak into every client's config file.
Product Card 2 Desc: Treat cost as a product signal, not a month-end bill. Aggregate tokens and spend by model, vendor, client and API Key, so every optimization is grounded in fact.
Feature 1 Tagline: One stable endpoint for all Agents
Feature 1 Desc: Bring Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and internal apps under one roof. When upstream changes, clients don't have to change with it.
Feature 2 Tagline: Turn model selection into maintainable rules
Feature 2 Desc: Define traffic paths with aliases, priority, weight and fallback chains; availability, performance and cost are always coordinated by the gateway.
Feature 3 Desc: Reconstruct tokens, cost, time-to-first-token and result status by user, Key, client, model and vendor.

Routing Alias Desc: Callers only need one stable contract
Workflow Desc: Roles differ, and so do integration paths. Platform admins build shared capabilities first; developers then use the configured model services — no more creating a Key with no callable model behind it.
Workflow Admin Desc: Own upstream, routing and access boundaries; configure once and the team calls through a unified contract.
Workflow Dev Desc: No need to manage vendor credentials or routing rules: get your own Key, generate a client config, and start calling.
Workflow Note Desc: Sign in to continue configuring and integrating within your permissions.
Governance Title: Bring model capabilities into team-governed bounds.
Governance Desc: From access Keys to vendor status, from model mappings to usage caps, Token Hub lets teams understand, configure and act in a single workspace.
Governance Card 1 Desc: Issue and revoke by member, app or scenario; call scope, quota policies and attribution travel with each Key.
Governance Card 2 Desc: Upstream secrets and routing policies no longer scatter across every client.
Governance Card 3 Desc: Put anomalies, excess, latency and cost on the same decision surface.
Cta Title: Start with one Key and let model calls grow in order.
